gaps.sentence: After twenty years of smoking, he finally managed to give it ___.
gaps.explanation: give up = stop/quit (a habit or attempt).

gaps.sentence: Please could you look ___ my plants while I'm away?
Can I ___ on these boots before buying them?
gaps.explanation: try on = put on clothes/shoes to check the fit.

gaps.sentence: Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
I can't make ___ what the sign says from here.
gaps.explanation: make out = see, hear or understand with difficulty.

gaps.sentence: The security guard waved us ___ without checking our passes.
gaps.explanation: 'Wave somebody through' = signal them to pass a checkpoint.

gaps.sentence: They put ___ the meeting until everyone could attend.
The publishers are bringing ___ a revised edition in the spring.
gaps.explanation: 'Bring out' = produce and publish a new product or edition.
